# Freelance hourly-rate calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/freelance-rate/

Estimate a sustainable billable rate from income, expenses and available hours. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Combine annual income and expenses, then divide by realistic billable hours after time off.

## Limits and checks

This is a planning estimate. Local taxes, unpaid time, benefits and client demand can change the rate you need.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
